messages.subject: Kingsmoor - contract mark-up (our comments)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Our mark-up of the contract attached. Key points from the Seller: (1) completion date moved to 1 May to fit the Seller's timetable; (2) a modest price adjustment to £14,150,000 reflecting the survey points; (3) contract rate to the Law Society rate; and (4) the Seller's liability limited to 15% of the price with a 6-month notice period and a £25,000 de minimis. We're content in principle with a retention for the Aldermere review.

Regards,

Zoe Abbott
Associate | Marlowe Greaves LLP

messages.subject: RE: Kingsmoor - contract mark-up (our comments)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Zoe,

Thank you. We can accept the £14.15m price, the 1 May completion date and the Law Society contract rate. On liability we can't accept 15%/6 months - we'll come back with the cap at 100% of the price and 18 months' notice, and a £10k de minisis, plus the retention mechanism at clause 9.3. Counter-markup to follow.

Regards,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
